evidence: A commenter explicitly recommends the Android app, spelling it Symphonium, and praises its Plex connection, Smart Flow playlists, and appearance; the official product is Symfonium.

evidence_sources.author: sourweasel
evidence_sources.excerpt: If you're on Android, I highly recommend trying the app Symphonium. It can connect to your Plex music library and the "Smart Flow" playlist bring all the auto DJ modes from Plex amp and add a few more options. It also looks far better imho.

source_story_title: How Not to Build a Music Player
